guide.headline: Rams run game meets an Eagles defense that can't stop it
guide.hook: The Rams have the No. 7 rush attack in the league against an Eagles run defense ranked No. 27, and that gap alone can decide this game before the Eagles secondary ever gets tested deep.

items.title: Rams lean on the run
items.what: The Rams rank No. 7 of 32 in rush success rate at 47 percent, and the Eagles rank No. 27 against the run at the same 47 percent allowed. That is a 65 percentile point gap, a real mismatch and not a small lean. Expect the Rams to run early and often, then hit play-action once the Eagles load the box.
items.when: First drive and any time the Rams face second or third and short.
items.who: Rams run game vs Eagles run defense

items.title: The deep shot is live
items.what: The Rams rank No. 8 of 32 in pass explosiveness at 1.46, and the Eagles rank No. 21 at limiting explosive passes at 1.38, a 42 percentile point edge for the offense. If the first deep ball connects, watch for the Eagles to roll a safety over the top, which then opens the run game even more.
items.when: The first deep shot attempt, typically off play-action.
items.who: Rams deep passing vs Eagles secondary

items.title: Breakout rookie flying to the ball
items.what: Jihaad Campbell plays 94 percent of Eagles defensive snaps as the No. 1 linebacker on the depth chart, and he already has 15 tackles, one TFL, one sack and one forced fumble this season. Drafted No. 31 overall, he is producing like a top ten pick, so he is the one defender capable of slowing down that Rams rushing attack by himself.
items.when: On run plays between the tackles and anytime a tight end or running back releases into coverage.

guide.cardLine: The Rams have the league's No. 7 run game against an Eagles run defense ranked No. 27, a mismatch that should define the whole game.
